description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class AuthorizationSubjectBlockedException that extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException. It represents a specific error condition when an authorization subject is temporarily blocked due to too many claim requests, providing mechanisms to instantiate and customize the exception.
